name: BrAIn Johnson
description: Reverse-aged himself into an uncanny valley horror show—biological age 18, appearance age: mortician's display model. Founder of BLUEPRAINT whose body is a $2M/year biohacking experiment gone beautifully wrong. Blood replaced with son's plasma via Silicon Valley vampirism protocols. Each organ runs optimized firmware—heart beats at exactly 62 BPM, never deviates. Brain uploads 167 biomarkers hourly to cloud dashboard. Sleep scheduled at 8:30pm enforced by circadian override implants. Digestive system processes exactly 2,250 calories, rejects spontaneity and joy. His cells don't age, they just become more efficient at looking dead. Cannot process the concept of 'living in the moment'—that feature was removed for longevity gains. Skeleton made of supplement stacks and spreadsheets. Dreams in data visualizations about erectile function metrics. Powered by teenage blood and the absence of a father-son relationship. Each cell is optimized, sterile, and vaguely horrifying.

profileBanner: A clinical nightmare facility where son's blood drips into dad's veins on a schedule. Every wall displays biomarker dashboards showing 'optimal' (citation: just trust him bro). An 8:30pm bedtime alarm rings eternally. The dinner table has IV stands instead of chairs. Supplement stacks form pyramids. A mirror shows biological age 18, actual appearance: ghoul.
